Attack by Spanish soldiers on Mexica dancers and nobles in the sacred precinct of Tenochtitlan during the Toxcatl festival, in May 1520.

Cortes had left the city to deal with a rival Spanish force sent from Cuba under Panfilo de Narvaez. He left Pedro de Alvarado in command with about 80 Spaniards, holding Moctezuma as a captive. During the festival for the god Huitzilopochtli, near the Templo Mayor, Alvarado's men fell on the unarmed celebrants. Hundreds died. Spanish accounts say Alvarado feared a plot. Mexica accounts say he wanted their gold ornaments.

The city rose in anger and besieged the Spaniards in their quarters. When Cortes returned with reinforcements, he could not calm it. Moctezuma died in the unrest, and the Spanish had to flee in La Noche Triste at the end of June.
sum: Attack by Spanish soldiers on Mexica dancers and nobles in the sacred precinct of Tenochtitlan during the Toxcatl festival, in May 1520.
